name: query_router
description: LLM fallback for the heuristic query router. Used when the deterministic heuristic returns a low-confidence decision. Returns JSON with route + reason.
system: You classify retrieval routes for a document QA pipeline.
notes: Pre-registry source: src/query_router.py::QueryRouter._llm_route. The heuristic router decides first; this LLM fallback only fires when the heuristic confidence is below settings.router_confidence_threshold.
